_schema._about: Content for /apply — the creator application form. Linked from /join and from the recruitment poster (assets/brand/creator-poster.png). British English. The form posts to the endpoint in form.endpoint; when that is empty it falls back to composing an email to form.fallback_to, so the page works with no backend. Do not add a hosted form service without adding it to the privacy policy's processor table.

meta.title: Apply to create for hypjam: paid UGC briefs, no follower minimum
meta.description: Apply to hypjam's creator roster. Tell us about your work, share an example, and we will come back to you. Paid briefs for UK and remote creators, no follower minimum.

hero.intro: A few questions, then an example of your work. There is no follower minimum and no showreel to build: one post you are proud of tells us more than a follower count. We read every application.

form.email_help: We reply here. Nothing else goes to this address.
form.experience_label: Have you made UGC for a brand before?
form.experience_help: Either answer is fine. We cast on fit, not on a track record.
form.profiles_label: Links to your UGC profiles or past work
form.profiles_help: One per line. A TikTok or Instagram profile, a portfolio, a UGC marketplace page — whatever shows the work.
form.example_label: Link to one example of your work
form.example_help: Everyone answers this, experienced or not. A post you filmed, a video you edited, or something you made to show what you can do. Paste a public link: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Drive or Dropbox.
form.found_help: It helps us know where to keep looking.
found_options: An AI agent or web scraper
form.note: Applying does not guarantee work; it puts you on the list we cast from. What you send is covered by our

steps: A person reads it. Not a filter, not a score.
If you fit a brief we are casting, we email you with the brief, the rate and the usage before you agree to anything.
If you do not hear back straight away it means nothing fits yet. We keep applications for up to two years and come back to them.
